title: DLF Magnolias Interior Design Guide: What Ultra-Luxury Buyers Are Choosing in 2026
author: Shivam Kumar

featuredImage.alt: Quiet-luxury living room interior by The Omega Group, with moulded wall panelling and layered lighting

excerpt: DLF Magnolias apartments are large, high-ceilinged and over a decade old. See what to update first, the 2026 design directions ultra-luxury buyers are choosing, and what a renovation costs.
keyTakeaways: Keep the Bones, Update the Systems — Generous rooms, ceiling heights and golf-course views are strengths; wiring, plumbing, AC and waterproofing are what's actually aged.
Services Come Before Design Spend — Survey, rewire, replumb and review air-conditioning before any joinery or finishes are chosen.
2026 Means Quiet Luxury — Calm palettes and warm natural materials, not heavy ornament or high-gloss everything.
Technology Should Be Invisible — Lighting scenes, climate control and audio controlled from a phone, with the hardware itself hidden.
Show Kitchen, Working Kitchen — An open island near the family lounge for entertaining, a closed kitchen behind it for daily cooking and staff.
Resale Buyers: Inspect Before You Sign — Bathrooms, the electrical panel and AC age tell you how much hidden work the renovation budget needs to cover.
contentHtml:
A DLF Magnolias interior is usually a renovation of a large, high-ceilinged 4BHK or 5BHK of about 6,400 to 9,800 sq ft. Update the hidden systems first (wiring, plumbing, air-conditioning, waterproofing and automation), then design around the golf-course view and the generous room heights. The 2026 direction is quiet, crafted luxury: warm natural materials, layered lighting, integrated technology and wellness spaces, rather than heavy ornament.

DLF The Magnolias is the largest of Golf Course Road's three DLF5 condominiums, with 589 homes in 19 towers. Most apartments are now well over a decade old, and resale prices have climbed to around ₹70,000 per sq ft. At that price, buyers rarely live with someone else's interiors. This guide covers DLF Magnolias interior design: what the building gives you, what to update first, and the design directions ultra-luxury buyers are choosing in 2026.

DLF Magnolias at a glance

DetailWhat is on record
LocationSector 42, Golf Course Road, within DLF Golf Links
Homes589 residences, including 25 penthouses (DLF)
Towers19 towers of about 24 storeys (DLF)

SizesAbout 5,825 to 9,800 sq ft; 4BHKs around 6,400 sq ft (listings)

RentsAbout ₹3.5 lakh to ₹6 lakh a month (listings)

Magnolias vs Aralias vs Camellias

The three DLF5 condominiums share a corridor but not a brief.

AraliasMagnoliasCamellias
Homes254589429
Typical briefRenovation of an older homeRenovation, often for a resale buyerBare-shell fit-out of a newer home
Typical sizesAbout 5,600 to 6,000 sq ft (4BHK)About 6,400 to 9,800 sq ftAbout 7,350 to 16,290 sq ft

For the other two, see our guides to DLF Aralias and DLF Camellias.

What the Magnolias floor plan gives you

  • Generous ceiling heights, with high or double-height living rooms in some larger configurations.
  • Large, well-separated rooms for formal living, family living and private suites.
  • Golf-course and green views from most towers.
  • Generous storage, utility and staff rooms, which make a well-run household easier.

These are strengths to keep. The work is in updating what has aged and adding what today's buyers expect.

Renovation priorities: what to do first

PriorityWhy it comes first
1. Survey structure and servicesShows what can stay and what must go before any design spend
2. Rewire and upgrade the distribution boardModern kitchens, AC and automation need more power and more circuits
3. Replace plumbing and rebuild wet areasBathrooms over a decade old are the most likely source of hidden leaks
4. Review air-conditioningOlder systems may be inefficient, noisy or near the end of their life
5. Plan automation and networkingConduits and control points go in before plaster and joinery
6. Restore or replace floorsRestore sound marble; replace only what has failed
7. Joinery, finishes and furnishingThe visible layer, done last

2026 design directions for ultra-luxury homes

These are the directions defining ultra-luxury briefs on Golf Course Road this year. Most good Magnolias interiors combine several.

1. Quiet luxury over ornament

Calm palettes, fewer and better pieces, and craftsmanship you notice up close. Heavy gilding, busy ceilings and high-gloss everything feel dated in a home of this calibre.

2. Warm natural materials

Book-matched stone used sparingly as a feature, natural wood veneers, fluted and textured panels, lime and mineral plasters, bouclé, linen and leather. Our comparison of Italian and contemporary luxury interiors covers the two dominant styles.

3. Lighting designed as architecture

High ceilings call for layered light: cove and linear lighting to wash walls, focused light on art and tables, statement pendants scaled to the room, and dimmable scenes for evenings.

4. Technology you do not see

Lighting scenes, climate control, motorised curtains, multi-room audio and security, all controlled from a phone or keypad, with speakers, sensors and equipment hidden. See our smart home interior design guide.

5. Kitchens that separate show from work

An open show kitchen or island near the family lounge, with a closed working kitchen behind for daily cooking and staff. Our kitchen layout guide explains the clearances an island needs.

6. Wellness at home

Spa-style primary bathrooms with steam showers, a home gym or yoga room in a spare bedroom, and air and water purification built into the services. Our guide to spa-style bathrooms has more ideas.

7. Walk-in wardrobes and dressing rooms

Converting a smaller bedroom or part of the primary suite into a walk-in wardrobe with lit, glass-fronted storage is one of the most requested upgrades in large apartments.

8. Art and collections built in

Planned walls, lighting and niches for art and collections, rather than adding them after the interior is finished.

Working in an occupied DLF tower

The Magnolias is a managed, occupied community. Before fixing a schedule:

  • Get the current renovation rules from the estate or society office: approvals, refundable deposits, work hours and lift use.
  • Have a structural engineer confirm any wall change, and get approval before demolition.
  • Plan noisy work within permitted hours and protect common lifts and corridors.
  • Schedule debris removal; it is one of the most common causes of friction with neighbours.

Cost and timeline

ItemTypical figure
Luxury interior rate in GurgaonAbout ₹2,500 to ₹8,000+ per sq ft (2026 planning range)
Full-home turnkey with The Omega GroupStarts at ₹15 lakh+, scaling with size and specification
Luxury turnkey timelineTypically 4 to 6 months; renovations with services or structural work can take longer

What moves a Magnolias budget most: how much of the services you replace, natural stone and bespoke joinery, kitchen and bathroom specification, automation and imported lighting. Long-lead imported items should be ordered as soon as the design is frozen. For extras most budgets miss, see our guide to hidden interior design costs.

If you are buying a resale Magnolias apartment

  1. Inspect before you sign: bathrooms, signs of leaks, the electrical panel and the age of the air-conditioning.
  2. Budget for the hidden work, not only the finishes.
  3. Plan design before possession, so work starts the day you get the keys.
  4. Check the society's renovation rules as part of your due diligence.

faqs.question: How big are DLF Magnolias apartments?
faqs.answer: DLF lists 589 residences, including 25 penthouses, across 19 towers. Listings show 4BHK apartments of around 6,400 sq ft and larger 5BHK, duplex and penthouse units up to about 9,800 sq ft. Confirm your exact size from the sale documents.

faqs.question: What interior styles suit a DLF Magnolias apartment in 2026?
faqs.answer: Quiet, crafted luxury: calm palettes, warm natural materials such as stone, wood veneer and textured plaster, layered architectural lighting, hidden technology and wellness spaces. Both contemporary and Italian-inspired styles work when they are restrained.

faqs.question: Should I renovate a resale DLF Magnolias apartment before moving in?
faqs.answer: Usually yes. Most homes are over a decade old, so wiring, plumbing, bathrooms and air-conditioning often need updating. It is easier and cheaper to do this before you move in than to work around a furnished, occupied home.

faqs.question: How long does a DLF Magnolias renovation take?
faqs.answer: Luxury turnkey projects in Gurgaon typically take 4 to 6 months. Renovations that replace services, rebuild bathrooms or need structural approval can take longer, especially with imported materials.

faqs.question: How much does interior design cost for a DLF Magnolias apartment?
faqs.answer: Luxury interiors in Gurgaon are planned at about ₹2,500 to ₹8,000+ per sq ft in 2026. On a 6,400 to 9,800 sq ft apartment, services replacement, stone, joinery, automation and lighting move the total most.

faqs.question: Do I need society approval for interior work in DLF Magnolias?
faqs.answer: Yes, for most significant work. Ask the estate office for current rules on approvals, deposits, work hours and lift use, and get structural changes signed off before demolition.
